meta.title: Recreate Order is offered on a live RFQ where Vendor An and Vendor B have bid

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ event on the buyer side.
Add the second bid required by the scenario without needing another vendor session.
Navigate to the live RFQ stage page where its Settings menu is available.
Assert that Recreate Order is offered and clickable in the RFQ Settings menu.
Select Recreate Order and leave its window open without confirming it.
Assert that selecting Recreate Order opens a dialog/window.
Cancel the Recreate Order window so no event data changes.
Assert that the Recreate Order window closes after cancellation.
